The operator was asked about The Bourne Betrayal in relation to identifying the actor for Jason Bourne, which in the context of the Bourne film series, is widely recognized as Matt Damon. The initial error stems from misunderstanding the question's intended scope (film vs. audiobook) and applying the audiobook narrator's role as a direct equivalent of an actor in the film. This interpretation error led to a mistaking of Jeremy Davidson as the primary actor for the title character across media.
